title: Meridian threshold
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, paragraph 4. The Threshold for Meridian Capital is USD 1,000,000. Exposure below the Threshold does not require a delivery of collateral.

title: Meridian minimum transfer
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, paragraph 5. The Minimum Transfer Amount is USD 250,000. A delivery smaller than the Minimum Transfer Amount is not required.

title: Meridian rounding
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, paragraph 6. Delivery and return amounts are rounded to the nearest USD 10,000. A delivery rounds up and a return rounds down.

title: Meridian independent amount
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, paragraph 7. The Independent Amount is USD 0. No initial margin is posted under this sample agreement.

title: Meridian eligible collateral
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, eligible collateral. USD cash is eligible and takes a zero haircut. Equity and other securities are not eligible under this sample agreement.

title: Meridian valuation agent
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, paragraph 9. The Valuation Agent is the party making the demand. Valuations use the previous business day close and notice is given by 1 pm local time.

title: Apex threshold
text: Apex Financial sample CSA, paragraph 4. The Threshold for Apex Financial is USD 500,000. The Minimum Transfer Amount is USD 100,000.

title: Apex rounding
text: Apex Financial sample CSA, paragraph 6. Delivery and return amounts are rounded to the nearest USD 10,000.

title: Apex eligible collateral
text: Apex Financial sample CSA, eligible collateral. USD cash and corporate bonds may be posted. A private loan is not eligible and does not count as coverage.

title: Apex independent amount
text: Apex Financial sample CSA, paragraph 7. The Independent Amount is USD 0.

title: Harbor Lane threshold
text: Harbor Lane sample CSA, paragraph 4. The Threshold is USD 0. The Minimum Transfer Amount is USD 50,000. Any positive net exposure above the Minimum Transfer Amount is called.

title: Harbor Lane rounding
text: Harbor Lane sample CSA, paragraph 6. Delivery and return amounts are rounded to the nearest USD 10,000.

title: Harbor Lane eligible collateral
text: Harbor Lane sample CSA, eligible collateral. USD cash is eligible with a zero haircut. No other asset is eligible under this sample agreement.

title: Close-out netting note
text: Sample agreement note. Exposure is netted across trades in one netting set before collateral is applied. This desk does not make a legal determination that netting is enforceable.

title: Dispute note
text: Sample agreement note. If the parties disagree on the exposure, the undisputed amount is transferred and the disputed amount follows the dispute resolution paragraph.

title: Cash haircut
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. Cash in the settlement currency has a haircut of 0 percent.

title: Government bond haircut, short maturity
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. Government bonds rated AAA to AA- with residual maturity one to five years have a haircut of 2 percent.

title: Government bond haircut, long maturity
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. Government bonds rated AAA to AA- with residual maturity over five years have a haircut of 4 percent.

title: Corporate bond haircut, one to five years
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. Corporate bonds rated A+ to BBB- with residual maturity one to five years have a haircut of 6 percent.

title: Corporate bond haircut, over five years
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. Corporate bonds rated A+ to BBB- with residual maturity over five years have a haircut of 12 percent.

title: Equity haircut
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. Main index equity has a haircut of 15 percent. Other equity has a haircut of 25 percent.

title: Gold haircut
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. Gold has a haircut of 15 percent.

title: Currency mismatch add-on
text: Haircut schedule used by this desk. When the collateral currency differs from the settlement currency, an additional 8 percent haircut is applied for the mismatch.

title: Schedule scope note
text: Haircut schedule note. This is the standardised schedule the calculator uses for the sample book. It is not the full published BCBS-IOSCO table and is not spot-checked against the source.
